name: Hong Kong Disneyland Hotel
description: The most prestigious hotel at Hong Kong Disneyland Resort — a magnificent Victorian-styled castle hotel directly connected to the park with stunning harbour and castle views. Features beautifully themed rooms, multiple pools, a full spa, award-winning restaurants and the most immersive Disney hotel atmosphere in Asia.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Elegantly themed Victorian room with Disney character decor, free WiFi and en-suite marble bathroom.

rooms.name: Castle View Room
rooms.description: Premium room with stunning views of the Sleeping Beauty Castle and fireworks from the window.

rooms.name: Character Suite
rooms.description: Lavishly themed suite with Disney princess or Mickey theming, separate living area and exclusive amenities.

name: Disney Hollywood Hotel
description: A glamorous Art Deco Hollywood golden age hotel celebrating the magic of Disney animation and cinema — Mickey-themed suites, a spectacular outdoor pool, multiple themed restaurants and free shuttle to Hong Kong Disneyland. The most stylish and entertaining hotel at the resort.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Art Deco styled room with Disney animation artwork, free WiFi and en-suite bathroom.

rooms.name: Character Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite themed around Mickey and friends with separate living area and premium amenities.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Larger deluxe room with upgraded Disney theming and premium bedding.

name: Disney Explorers Lodge
description: A stunning nature-themed hotel celebrating the spirit of exploration and discovery — Disney Explorers Lodge features lush jungle gardens, four themed courtyards representing different regions of the world and beautifully appointed rooms with nature-inspired Disney theming. The most unique and visually spectacular hotel at Hong Kong Disneyland Resort.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Nature-inspired themed room with explorer decor, free WiFi and en-suite bathroom.

rooms.name: Explorer Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite themed to a specific world region with separate living area and lush garden views.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Larger deluxe room with upgraded nature theming and premium furnishings.

name: Penny's Bay Hotel
description: A modern and comfortable hotel near Hong Kong Disneyland Resort offering affordable rooms with easy MTR access to the park and Hong Kong city. The most accessible and budget-friendly base for visiting Hong Kong Disneyland.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Comfortable modern room with free WiFi, flat-screen TV and en-suite bathroom near Disneyland MTR.

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.description: Larger superior room with upgraded furnishings and park or garden views.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Spacious family room sleeping up to 4 guests with extra beds and complimentary breakfast.
